## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invite validator still has an eight-character minimum, so one password path does not get the twelve-character requirement this pull request is meant to apply. This should be fixed before the change is relied on to meet the security policy.

## Changes
The pull request raises `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` from 8 to 12 in `app/signup.py` and `app/reset.py`. It moves the boundary tests in `tests/test_signup.py` and `tests/test_reset.py` to lengths 11, 12 and 13, and adds a one-line `review.txt`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Raise the invite validator minimum to twelve — An invite password of 8 to 11 characters, such as `"x" * 10`, is still accepted, because `app/invite.py:1` keeps `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8` while signup and reset now use 12. The PR body says the change "raises the minimum in the password validators", and the invite validator is defined the same way. — Users who join through an invite can set passwords shorter than the twelve characters the security policy now requires. — Fix: Set `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 12` at `app/invite.py:1` and update the boundary list and expected result in `tests/test_invite.py:6-8` the way `tests/test_signup.py` was updated.
